issues.failure_explanation: In (KILLING_THE_DRIFT) the second derivative of the stable kernel is evaluated at $\tilde y-z$ perturbed by $[b(r,\tilde y)+\mu(b(r,z)-b(r,\tilde y))](s-\tau_s^h)$, a perturbation of size up to $C(1+|z-\tilde y|^\beta)(s-\tau_s^h)$. Since the $z$-integration runs over all of $\R^d$ and $|z-\tilde y|^\beta$ is unbounded, this perturbation exceeds the diagonal scale $(t-\tau_s^h)^{1/\alpha}$ for large $|z-\tilde y|$ (even using $s-\tau_s^h\le t-\tau_s^h$). The invoked estimate (drift-smoothing-iso-noise-diag) is stated and proved only under the constraint $|y-y'|\lesssim(t-s)^{1/\alpha}$, so the inference is invalid as written and the displayed bound, although true, is left unestablished without an additional off-diagonal argument.

issues.failure_explanation: Since $0<\gamma/\alpha<1$ and $0<1/\alpha<1$, the Beta-type integral satisfies $\int_h^t s^{-\gamma/\alpha}(t-s)^{-1/\alpha}ds \to t^{1-\gamma/\alpha-1/\alpha}B(1-\gamma/\alpha,1-1/\alpha) = C\,t^{-\beta/\alpha}$ as $h\to0$, which is unbounded as $t\downarrow0$ (note $1-\gamma/\alpha-1/\alpha=-\beta/\alpha<0$). Because the $\lesssim$ constant may depend only on $(d,b,\alpha,T)$, the final step of (maj-D2-mainthm), which treats this integral as $O(1)$, is false; the correct bound for $\Delta_2$ is $\lesssim\bar p_\alpha(t,y-x)h^{\gamma/\alpha}t^{-\beta/\alpha}$.
